invariants.rationale: Profile is actively used throughout the method and accessed for methods and fields, so it must be non-null at method exit.
Context is passed to and used within the method and must remain non-null at completion.
The collection of partition paths is used in multiple places, so it should not be null at exit.
partitionPathToInsertBucketInfos is updated for each partition path and therefore must be initialized and non-null.
updateLocationToBucket is checked and updated inside the loop, so it must be properly initialized and non-null at method exit.
